principles: Observation age is the sum of source measurement age and one-way light delay.
Position uncertainty grows from angular and range error, velocity uncertainty, acceleration uncertainty, and target maneuver authority.
Target combat delta-v limits the duration of sustained maneuver but does not erase short-term lateral displacement.
Sensor agreement, identity confidence, signature confidence, deception probability, and competing hypotheses remain separate values.
Fire-control readiness requires surviving sensor, data, power, cooling, and fire-control channels from VESSEL-05 effective graphs.
A destroyed or incoherent observing vessel cannot retain a valid track or fire-control solution.
VESSEL-06 is weapon-independent and must not define weapon ranges, hit probability, projectile behavior, beam divergence, or local impact voxels.
